column3: 画面内容
小镇的病房里，窗台上的花瓶中有一束向日葵，阳光穿透玻璃
Iris坐在床头，看着那束花，表情很平静
Theo推门进来，脸上带着宽慰，拿着病历，说
column8: Theo (genuinely at ease): Best medical team money can buy — all fees signed off by someone who said it was owed to you.

column3: Iris没有没回头，还是看着那束花
Theo把病历放在床头，看着Iris，表情有些无奈，走了出门
咖啡馆里阳光很好，人们欢快地交谈，Luna和Caius坐在靠窗的伽罗
Luna双手手肘撑在桌子上，仰起脸看着Caius，说
column8: Luna (serious, face tilted up): So, you are my daddy?

column3: Caius微笑
Luna紧张地说，眼眶逐渐变红
column8: Luna (cont., voice going quiet, eyes slowly reddening): Then you have to save Mama. Mama's not well right now... is it because she had me? Is that why she's like this?

column3: Caius走到Luna的旁边，坐在她的身边，看着她，温柔地说
column8: Caius (crouching, eye level, very soft): No. That's not true.

column3: Luna憋着嘴看着Caius，把眼泪憋了回去
Caius温柔地说
column8: Caius (cont., one word at a time): You are your mama's angel. From before you were even born, you were already protecting her.

column3: 阳光覆盖两人，Caius停顿了一下，说
column8: Caius (cont., lower, softer): And you're my hero too.

column3: Luna用手背抹了抹眼睛，说
column8: Luna (wiping her eyes, voice a little rough): Really?

column3: Caius温柔点了点头，说
Luna忽然凑上前来，对着Caius说
column8: Luna (leaning in, very serious): But Mama really doesn't like you right now. If she finds out I came to see you, she'll be upset.

column3: Caius看向一旁，眼神有些没落，他转回头又回到温柔的神情，伸出了手说
column8: Caius (serious): Then let's keep it between us for now. I'll work on it — slowly. Until Mama stops being upset with me. Deal?

column3: Luna点了点头，伸出手
两人的手拉了拉勾，一根粗大的手指和一根小小的手指，勾在一起。
Luna从椅子上下来，拍了拍衣服，越过Caius准备离开
Caius看着Luna，温柔的表情
Luna又回过头，微微笑看着Caius，说
column8: Luna (looking back, matter-of-fact): I'll come back tomorrow.

column3:
阳光照在Caius背后，Caius逆光，Caius点了点头，又伸出手
Luna拿过那个东西
Luna从前景走开
Caius看着Luna走开，神情变得有些落寞
咖啡馆里的人都在快乐地交谈，只有Caius坐在靠窗的角落，有些忧郁
